parent_objective: audit source-diverse history-intervention public pass and evidence-quality failure
blocked_by: M1573 passes public gates but fails evidence-quality targets with history positives concentrated in t5_near_boundary_warmup

public_gates: M1574 must audit M1573 public pass and evidence-quality failure
M1574 must separate live intervention harness evidence from source-diverse self-ID evidence
M1574 must explain high-speed third-source and late-reveal null results
M1574 must choose donor-pairing repair, source-family repair, branch synthesis, stop, or pivot
M1574 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1573 live intervention public pass and evidence-quality failure
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no simulator run, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats t5_near-only history positives as source-diverse self-ID evidence
stop if audit ignores high-speed third-source null
stop if audit routes directly to materialization, training, PPO, promotion, or private holdout
fallback_plan: design donor-pairing repair if evidence suggests donor mismatch caused source narrowing
design source-family active-set repair if high-speed anchors are locally inactive for history
route to branch synthesis if another narrow repair would chase public gates
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1573 completed bounded intervention smoke and requires audit

admission_evidence: M1573 evidence-quality targets failed because history positives are source-narrow
allowed_updates: M1574 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits it
next_stage_criteria: high-speed and late-reveal nulls are discussed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1573 includes controls, but audit must verify whether positives are source-diverse and not dominated by current-frame controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-diverse history evidence remains narrow, record the null and route to repair/synthesis rather than lowering self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1573's public-pass/evidence-narrow result can be audited into a defensible next route without overstating self-identification evidence.
success_criteria: audit summarizes M1573 public and evidence-quality results
audit separates live harness evidence from source-diverse history evidence
audit discusses high-speed third-source null and late-reveal null
training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export materialization and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats M1573 as level3 self-ID evidence
audit routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes or candidate materialization
decision_rule: M1574 passes if it audits M1573 and chooses the next route before any repair, materialization, or training.
